test_title: PYST 26: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 27 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

I can't __getting my__ wife to go swimming.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the verb** "getting" **which should be corrected to **"get" **to match the structure **"can't get"**.
 
• The correct phrase should be **"I can't get my wife to go swimming,"** ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in the underlined part of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I** can't get my wife **to go swimming."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: No improvement** – This would be the correct option if the original sentence were already correct, but it contains an error.
 
• **Option 3: gets my** – This is incorrect because the verb "gets" does not fit the sentence structure.
 
• **Option 4: get I** – This is incorrect because it disrupts the proper subject-verb-object order.
